blocks.html:
This workflow updates one or more promotion rules. It's used by other workflows,
such as [batchPromotionRulesWorkflow](/references/core_flows/Promotion/Workflows_Promotion/functions/core_flows.Promotion.Workflows_Promotion.batchPromotionRulesWorkflow) that manages the rules of a promotion.

You can use this workflow within your own customizations or custom workflows, allowing you to
update promotion rules within your custom flows.
